The noncalcareous part of the solum is 10 to 16 inches thick. Some pedons have gravelly sand below 40 inches. Hue is 10YR through 5Y. The Al horizon is silt loam or loam. The Ap horizon is silty clay loam or clay loam. Color range is grayish brown and light brownish gray. The B2t horizon contains 35 to 45 percent clay. Color range is grayish brown, light yellowish brown and brown. The Cca horizon has color range of light gray, pale yellow, light olive gray, and pale olive. Calcium carbonate accumulation is in few to common fine threads and soft masses in a Bca and Cca horizon.
Thurlow soils are associated with Midway, Hydro, McRae and Fort Collins soils. They contain more clay than the Fort Collins soils. They have a B2t horizon not present in the McRae soils. They lack the shale bedrock of the Midway soils. They differ from the Hydro soils in having no A & B or B & A horizons.
